items.item_text: 1-3 years; minimum 2 years of work experience in a hospital setting in environmental services.
1-3 years of 2 years' work experience in a hospital setting with carpet shampoo and floor care machines in environmental services.

Consistently completes assigned work on time while meeting quality, safety, and regulatory standards. Informs supervisor immediately of circumstances that may result in an inability to complete assigned work. Meets annual competency requirements before evaluation date.
Able to complete at least 75% of the tasks and duties that are defined in the Environmental Service Worker Job Tasks.(Attached) More than 75% exceeds standards for job knowledge.
Demonstrates satisfactory attendance and reliability. Has fewer than 4 absences or instances of tardiness each year. Less than 4 occurrences exceeds standards for attendance.
Acquires knowledge relative to the healthcare Environmental Services field by attending all in-service sessions offered or by seeking out information from supervisors.
Participates in meetings and contributes towards performance improvement efforts in the department and in the organization.
Attains personal goals for performance improvement agreed upon in previous evaluations
